# Approval gate on resume: `--approve-plan`, `--replan <file>`, re-plan of a run still planning

## What to build

A run started with `--content` stops at `awaiting-approval` by default (exit code 5, `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL`): the plan (`docs/prd/<name>.md`, `.agents/tasks/<name>/`) is committed on `graph/<run-id>` as `Plan: <name>`, and `state.json` has `specPath`, `tasksDir`, `hashes`, `tasks` and `plan.name`. This slice lets a human answer that stop through resume:

- `graph-execution --resume --run <id> --approve-plan` sets the run to `running` and continues it exactly as a normal resume (tasks, review, apply) until `applied`.
- `graph-execution --resume --run <id> --replan <file>` appends the file's text to `plan.feedback`, sets the run back to `planning`, removes the previous plan commit (the integration branch goes back to the run's starting commit), and plans again with all feedback in the planner's prompt and the rejected commit named; then it stops at `awaiting-approval` again (the gate stays on) or ends `needs-info`/`failed` as a first plan would.
- `--resume` of an `awaiting-approval` run without either flag is a usage error naming both flags; either flag on a run that is not `awaiting-approval`, or either flag without `--resume`, is a usage error (exit 2).
- `--resume` of a run still in `planning` (its process was killed) plans again from scratch, keeping `plan.feedback`.

All of this works with `--web` and in a graph-manager sandbox (`--resume --run <id> --sandbox --approve-plan` from a graph-manager terminal, and graph-manager's own resume of a sandboxed run passes the flags through).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/automation-api.md` ("Decisions": the gate exits the process, resume with `--approve-plan`/`--replan`; "Requirements > Engine > CLI / Resume"; acceptance criteria 2 and 3).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` — `runPlanned` (plan stage: state in `planning`, `planStage` rounds up to `config.planAttempts`, needs-info, commit, gate), `resume()` (lines ~205–268: `preflight({ resume: true })`, `acquireLock`, `reapOrphans`, `reconcile`, `status = "running"`, `execute`), `execute` (private).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/stage.ts`, `src/plan/prompt.ts` (`PlannerPromptInput`, `## Previous attempt`), `src/plan/paths.ts` (`runInputs`, `integrationWorktreeOf`, `planSpecRel`, `planTasksRel`, `planContentPath`, `planRefsPath`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/preflight.ts` — `preflightResume` (refuses `planning`, `needs-info` and `awaiting-approval` today with "cannot resume run <id>: …"; the sandbox check at the top; `assertNoLeftoverWorktrees`; hashes from `runInputs`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/resume.ts` (lines 48–110 `reconcile`: re-adds a missing integration worktree, cleans it).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/git/git.ts` — `resetHard` (lines 121–124), `addWorktree`, `resolveRef`, `pruneWorktrees`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts` — the action (resume branch, `--web` launcher preflight options, `serveWeb` resume call and its handling of `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL`/`EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`), `RunOptions`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/paths.ts` (`RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS`) — `--replan` takes a value.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/abort.ts` (`resumeCommand`) — sandbox-aware hint text.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.ts` (lines 34–90 `resumeRun`: sandboxed runs start a container with `args: ["--resume", "--run", runId]`, other runs run `--resume --run <id> --web` through `engineCommand`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.ts` (`scanArgs`, the `scan.resume` branch of `POST /api/internal/sandbox-runs`) and `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-paths.ts` (`PATH_OPTIONS`).
- Tests to mirror: `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` lines 628–663 ("resumes a sandboxed run only with GRAPH_EXECUTION_SANDBOX=1"), 516–531 (flags refused on `--resume`); `src/state/resume.test.ts` (lines 14–60 in-process resume); `src/plan/stage.test.ts` (in-process `runPlanned`); `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.test.ts` (lines 20–46 `writeState`, 112–131 sandboxed resume asserting the container `Cmd`); `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.test.ts` (lines 149–154 `--resume` cases).

## Patterns to follow

**Resume flow (`src/runner/run.ts` `resume`):**
```typescript
const pre = await preflight({ cwd: opts.cwd, resume: true, runId: opts.runId, providerInstance: opts.providerInstance });
const release = await acquireLock(runDir);
try {
  await reapOrphans(runDir, { log });
  await reconcile(state, repo, runDir);
  state.status = "running";
  await store.save();
  return await execute(ctx, tasks, store, { ...runInputs(state, runDir), model: state.model, concurrency: state.concurrency, ... });
} finally { await release(); }
```

**Usage errors on resume (`src/launch/preflight.ts` `preflightResume`):**
```typescript
throw new UsageError(`cannot resume run ${state.runId}: it already finished (${state.status}); ...`);
```

**Sandbox resume in graph-manager (`routes/resume.ts`):**
```typescript
await sandboxes.start({ ws, cwd: ws.path, args: ["--resume", "--run", runId], runId, providers: [state.provider], ... });
const cmd = engineCommand(ctx.config.graphExecutionBin, ["--resume", "--run", runId, "--web"]);
```

**Test pattern:** `src/cli.test.ts` `run([...], repo, env)` on the built CLI; first create an awaiting-approval run with `run(["--content", c, "--provider", "fake"], repo)` (exit 5) and read the run id from the `Run <id>:` line.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts` and `src/state/paths.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - Options `--approve-plan` ("with --resume: approve the plan of a run waiting for approval and run it") and `--replan <file>` ("with --resume: reject the plan with this feedback (markdown) and plan again"). `RunOptions` adds `approvePlan?: boolean; replan?: string`.
  - Pass both into every `preflight` call that can be a resume (the `--web` launcher options and the plain `--resume` branch) and into `resume({ ..., approvePlan, replan })` in the plain branch and in `serveWeb`. In `serveWeb`'s resume call also pass `planningUi: web.ui` (a re-plan shows the planning page like a first plan).
  - `RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS` adds `"--replan"`.
- **GOTCHA**: `--web` keeps every other argument (`process.argv.slice(2).filter((a) => a !== "--web")`), so the detached `--web-serve` process gets the flags too. `serveWeb` already closes the page and exits for `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL`/`EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build -w graph-execution && npx vitest run src/cli.test.ts -t "RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS"` (from `packages/graph-execution`)

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/preflight.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `PreflightOptions` adds `approvePlan?: boolean; replan?: string`.
  - Not resume: either flag → `UsageError("--approve-plan can only be used with --resume")` / `UsageError("--replan can only be used with --resume")`.
  - `preflightResume`, after the sandbox check and the applied/done check:
    - both flags → `UsageError("--approve-plan and --replan cannot be used together")`.
    - `awaiting-approval` without a flag → `UsageError(\`run ${id} waits for approval of its plan: resume it with --approve-plan to run it, or with --replan <file> to plan again with your feedback\`)`.
    - a flag on any other status → `UsageError(\`--approve-plan: run ${id} is not waiting for approval (status ${status})\`)` (same with `--replan`).
    - `--replan <file>`: check the file with `checkInputFile(file, "feedback")` (missing/empty → exit 2) and read its text.
    - `awaiting-approval` + `--approve-plan` → continue to the existing hash check and task loading; return kind `resume` as today (add `approvePlan: true` to it).
    - `awaiting-approval` + `--replan`, and `planning` (with or without nothing) → return a new kind `{ kind: "replan"; repo; runDir; store; config; provider; feedback?: string }` without the hash check and without loading tasks (there may be none).
    - `needs-info` stays refused (final).
- **GOTCHA**: The sandbox check (`state.sandbox && SANDBOX_ENV !== "1"`) must stay first, so a sandboxed run is only approved from a sandbox. Keep `assertNoLeftoverWorktrees(repo, runId, <runDir>/worktrees)` for every kind.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/launch/preflight.test.ts`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/prompt.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `PlannerPromptInput` adds `feedback: string[]` and `rejectedCommit?: string`. When feedback is non-empty add `## Feedback on earlier plans` (before `## Result`): "A human rejected the earlier plan(s) with this feedback. Write a new plan that answers all of it." and each feedback text in its own `fence()`, numbered, oldest first; with `rejectedCommit`: "The last rejected plan is commit `<sha>`: read it with `git show <sha>`." Keep the `## Previous attempt` section for validation errors.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/plan/prompt.test.ts`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - Split the planning part of `runPlanned` (everything after the state exists, the branch exists and the integration worktree is added: planning UI, round loop, needs-info, failure, commit, hashes, gate or `execute`) into a private `planAndContinue(ctx, store, opts)` used by both `runPlanned` and resume.
  - `ResumeOptions` adds `approvePlan?: boolean; replan?: string; planningUi?: ...`.
  - `resume()`:
    - kind `resume` with `approvePlan`: as today (reap orphans, `reconcile`, `status = "running"`, `execute` with `runInputs(state, runDir)`); log `plan <name> approved`.
    - kind `replan`: take the lock, `reapOrphans`, `pruneWorktrees`; the integration branch must exist (else `Error("cannot resume: the integration branch <b> no longer exists")`); re-add the integration worktree when missing (`addWorktree(repo, integrationWorktreeOf(runDir), state.integrationBranch)`); remember `rejected = state.plan?.name ? await currentHead(worktree) : undefined` (the `Plan: <name>` commit) and `resetHard(worktree, state.startingCommit)` (removes the previous plan commit's files); update the state: append the feedback text to `plan.feedback` (when given), delete `specPath`, `tasksDir`, `hashes`, `plan.name`, `plan.error`, set `tasks = {}`, `review = initialReviewState()`, `plan.questions = []`, `plan.dropped = []`, `plan.attempts = 0`, `status = "planning"`, save; log `planning again with your feedback` (or `planning again from the start` without feedback); then `planAndContinue` with `rejectedCommit = rejected` and `feedback = plan.feedback` in every planner prompt. The gate setting comes from `state.plan.gate`, the refs from `state.plan.refs` (and `planRefsPath(runDir)`), the content from `plan.contentPath`, the overrides from `state.overrides`.
- **GOTCHA**: The run keeps its run id, `startingCommit`, `integrationBranch`, `createdAt`, `sandbox` and `targetBranch`. `resetHard` runs `git clean -fd` too, which removes anything a killed planner left. The plan name may be the same as before: the name check compares with the starting commit, where the old files do not exist.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/plan/stage.test.ts src/state/resume.test.ts`

### UPDATE graph-manager (`apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.ts`, `routes/internal.ts`, `sandbox-paths.ts`)

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `ResumeOptions` (resume.ts line 15) adds `planArgs?: string[]` (exactly `["--approve-plan"]` or `["--replan", <path>]`). `resumeRun` appends them: sandbox `args: ["--resume", "--run", runId, ...planArgs]`; local `["--resume", "--run", runId, ...planArgs, "--web"]`.
  - `scanArgs` records `approvePlan: true` for `--approve-plan` and `replan` for `--replan <file>`/`--replan=<file>`. In the sandbox-runs route's resume branch, a `--replan` file must be inside the workspace (400 `replan: <x> is not a file inside the workspace`); pass `planArgs` (with the path relative to the workspace root, `/` separators) to `resumeRun`.
  - `PATH_OPTIONS` adds `"--replan"`.
- **GOTCHA**: `resumeRun` refuses a live run (409 "the run is live"); an `awaiting-approval` run has no live page because its process exited, so approval goes through. The API approve/reject endpoints of a later slice call `resumeRun` with these `planArgs`; keep the signature as described.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build -w graph-execution && cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/routes/resume.test.ts src/server/routes/internal.test.ts src/server/sandbox-paths.test.ts`

### UPDATE docs: `packages/graph-execution/README.md`

- **IMPLEMENT**: Usage synopsis `graph-execution --resume --run <id> --approve-plan|--replan <file> [--web]`, table rows for both flags, and in "Resume" a paragraph: an `awaiting-approval` run needs one of the two flags; `--replan` removes the plan commit and plans again with the feedback (kept in `plan.feedback`); a run killed while planning plans again from scratch; `needs-info` cannot be resumed.

### CREATE / UPDATE tests

- `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` (regression, mirror lines 628–663):
  - awaiting-approval run (`--content c.md --provider fake`, exit 5) → `--resume --run <id> --approve-plan` exits 0, state `applied`, `1.txt` on `graph/<id>`.
  - `--resume --run <id> --replan fb.md` (fb.md = "Split it in two") → exit 5, state `awaiting-approval`, `plan.feedback == ["Split it in two"]`, exactly one `Plan: fake-plan` commit on `graph/<id>` (`git log --format=%s`), and with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_PROMPTS=<dir>` the file `<dir>/planner-plan.md` contains `Split it in two` and `git show`.
  - `--resume --run <id>` without a flag → exit 2, stderr contains `--approve-plan` and `--replan`.
  - `--approve-plan` without `--resume` → exit 2; `--approve-plan` on a run that is not awaiting approval → exit 2; both flags → exit 2; `--replan missing.md` → exit 2.
  - sandbox: create the awaiting-approval run with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_SANDBOX=1`; `--resume --run <id> --approve-plan` without it → exit 2 with the "ran in a sandbox" hint; with `GRAPH_EXECUTION_SANDBOX=1` → exit 0.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/stage.test.ts` (in process): a run killed in `planning` (write a state with `status: "planning"` by stopping after the state save, e.g. a fake planner attempt with `hang: true` and aborting via `signal`, or by editing state.json) resumes with `resume({ cwd, runId })` and plans again; `plan.feedback` is kept.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web-e2e.test.ts`: `--resume --run <id> --approve-plan --web` (detached) serves the page and ends with `summary.exitCode === 0`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/resume.test.ts`: `resumeRun(…, { planArgs: ["--approve-plan"] })` on a sandboxed `awaiting-approval` state → container `Cmd` contains `--resume`, `--run`, `<id>`, `--approve-plan`, `--web-serve`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.test.ts`: `["--resume", "--run", ID, "--approve-plan"]` and `["--resume", "--run", ID, "--replan", "fb.md"]` reach the container `Cmd`; a `--replan` path outside the workspace → 400. `scanArgs` covers both flags.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With the gate on, `--content c.md --provider fake` ends `awaiting-approval` (exit 5); then `--resume --run <id> --approve-plan` finishes it as `applied` (exit 0).
- [ ] `--resume --run <id> --replan fb.md` plans again, `plan.feedback` contains the feedback text, the planner prompt contains it, and the old plan commit is gone from `graph/<id>`.
- [ ] `--resume` of an `awaiting-approval` run without a flag exits 2 with a message naming `--approve-plan` and `--replan <file>`.
- [ ] `--approve-plan`/`--replan` without `--resume`, together, or on a run not awaiting approval exit 2.
- [ ] A run killed while `planning` re-plans from scratch on `--resume`.
- [ ] Sandboxed runs: the flags are refused outside a sandbox with the existing hint, work inside one, and graph-manager's resume passes them to the container.
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm run build -w graph-execution && npm test -w graph-execution && npm test -w graph-manager`

## Validation commands

```bash
# Type / lint
npm run typecheck && npm run lint

# Tests for this slice
npm run build -w graph-execution
cd packages/graph-execution && npx vitest run src/plan src/cli.test.ts src/launch/preflight.test.ts src/state/resume.test.ts src/web-e2e.test.ts && cd ../..
cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/routes/resume.test.ts src/server/routes/internal.test.ts src/server/sandbox-paths.test.ts && cd ../..

# Whole suite
npm test
```

Known environment failure: `src/cli.test.ts` "exits 2 at startup when --provider claude is not on the PATH" fails wherever a real `claude` is installed next to `node`.
